# Shake

An extendable-output function: absorb a message, then read as many bytes as wanted.

```rux
pub struct Shake {
    // private fields
}
```

Structural `Copy`; copying takes an independent snapshot of the sponge and read position.

## Associated functions

<h3 id="new-128"><code>New128</code></h3>

```rux
pub func New128() -> Shake
```

A SHAKE128 state: 128 bits of security, absorbing 168 bytes at a time.

**Returns**: a SHAKE128 sponge, which produces output of any length

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Crypto/Src/Shake.rux#L47)

<h3 id="new-256"><code>New256</code></h3>

```rux
pub func New256() -> Shake
```

A SHAKE256 state: 256 bits of security, absorbing 136 bytes at a time.

**Returns**: a SHAKE256 sponge, which produces output of any length

## Methods

<h3 id="update"><code>Update</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Update(self: &var Shake, bytes: char8[..])
```

Absorbs `bytes` into the state.
Absorbing after reading has begun is a caller error: the stream is a function of everything absorbed
before the first read, and adding to it afterwards would silently change what a caller already has. This
ignores such a call rather than corrupting the stream.

| Name    | Type        | Description         |
| ------- | ----------- | ------------------- |
| `bytes` | `char8[..]` | the bytes to absorb |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Crypto/Src/Shake.rux#L64)

<h3 id="read"><code>Read</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Read(self: &var Shake, into: var char8[..])
```

Fills `into` with the next bytes of the stream.
Reading is continuous: any sequence of reads totalling the same number of bytes gives the same bytes.
The first read applies the padding, after which [`Update`](/docs/api/crypto/shake#update) does nothing.

| Name   | Type            | Description         |
| ------ | --------------- | ------------------- |
| `into` | `var char8[..]` | receives the output |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Crypto/Src/Shake.rux#L100)

<h3 id="rate"><code>Rate</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Rate(self: &Shake) -> uint
```

How many bytes the state absorbs or squeezes before permuting.

**Returns**: how many bytes the sponge absorbs or squeezes per permutation

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Crypto/Src/Shake.rux#L122)
